_note: Poison on atronachs, gargoyles and ash guardians: there is nothing to poison; the venom burns off, freezes or flakes away. Overrides the poisoning source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the poison hissing off {name}. {name} pays it no mind.
, the venom clinging and staining. {name} presses on.
, and the poison eats into the cracks. Pieces flake away.
, and it is too much. The poison has eaten into the binding; {name} falls apart.

head: the poison eats into {name}'s head; the light flares and {name} collapses.
{name}'s head flakes away; the form falls apart.
body: the poison eats into {name}'s core; the binding breaks and {name} collapses.
{name}'s core flakes apart; the form falls.
arm: {name}'s {part} flakes away and the rest follows.
lower: the poison eats through {name}'s {part}; {name} falls apart.
